# ⚠️ breadth is a REQUEST: it is spent as an equal per-sub-corpus quota, so the

# ⛔ PINNED, not re-derived per run. A sample that re-selects itself from the
# tree it is measuring can shed the file that regressed and report an
# improvement. Re-derivation is a deliberate, reviewed act.
# ⛔⛔ DECLARED PROVENANCE — THIS SAMPLE'S `lr` TIER WAS RANKED BY THE PRE-`.21`
# CLASSIFIER, which saw 97 of the parser's 127 LR rule names and missed 75.1 %
# re-derived the sample under the CORRECTED classifier and DECLINED to adopt it,
# on a measurement rather than a preference:
#   hot      0 of 40 rows change   (the tier carrying the bulk of the entries)
#   breadth 19 of 112 change       (a consequence: breadth fills what hot+lr leave)
#   => the ratchet's binding baseline would move +0.40 %, and coverage of the
#      LR-elimination family — the mechanism the tier exists for — would improve
#      by +0.45 %. A one-time reset of every historical comparison buys 0.45 %.
# ⭐ A classifier wrong about 75.1 % of the family's ENTRIES changed the sample it
# ranks by under half a percent: a ranking is far more robust to a systematic
# undercount than a share is. The correction was still necessary — the published
# SHARE was wrong by 4x — but the SELECTION it fed barely moved.
